definition: PyTorch Lightning organises PyTorch code so the training loop, multi-GPU, mixed precision and checkpointing are handled for you.
details: Created by William Falcon in 2019 while at NYU and Facebook AI Research; developed by Lightning AI.

explainer.lead: How to install PyTorch Lightning, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.inAi: Scale the same model from a laptop to many GPUs by changing Trainer arguments (devices, strategy="ddp", precision="bf16-mixed").
explainer.jsNote: PyTorch Lightning is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.
